steps.content: You stand at the entrance of the common lounge, eyes drifting across walls blanketed in a riot of colorful idol posters, unsure what to do or make of the situation.
So much for a classified project... Honestly, kids these days...
You open your mouth, caught between a "Sorry to interrupt" and a "Please, go on." Ultimately, words fail you, and all you can do is awkwardly stare at the paralyzed trio.

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: Ah.

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: Enya, you dropped your chips. You still want those?

Enya shakes her head with stiff, mechanical motion. In the thick, near-suffocating silence, one soul remains blissfully detached from the gravity of the moment, launching herself into the room with a buoyant bound.
Summer picks up the fallen bag of chips from the floor, digs some out, and starts munching away with loud, unabashed crunches.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Sup guys! It's been a hot minute!
At last, the sheer mortification in the room dawns on her.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Oh, come on. You're all still so shy about this stuff? It's been years! If you really like something, just own it. Be loud about it, like me! There's no need to be embarrassed!
She glances at the posters on the wall.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Huh... wait. I remember when I bailed five years ago, you guys were into someone totally different. Back then it was all "so-and-so's the best" and "I can't wait for this and that," wasn't it?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Did your taste change, or did your old fave get cancelled?
You sweep your gaze across the room. Someone's face has definitely shifted.
Summer is still mid-sentence when Enya, visibly agitated and clutching two light sticks, cuts her off.

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: Hey! It's called a "graduation." A normal graduation. Unlike a certain senior who's been on the school roster forever and still doesn't have a degree.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Ohhh, is that so? I'm so happy, Enya. You still call me senior.
She breaks into a wicked grin. Enya's expression slowly melts into a deep, spreading blush, almost like those words were a switch.

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: You... Don't think you can still pull rank on me just because you're my senior—

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: Enya, stay calm! Summer's been held back for years. You've already graduated. Technically, you're the senior now. Don't stoop to her level.

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: ...Y-you're right! We're operating on entirely different planes now, Summer! What would a shallow, flavor-of-the-month fan like you know about our true, undying loyalty to Phanuel?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: See, that's where you're wrong. If we're talking pure charisma, real people literally got nothing on anime characters. Just look at these G*nd*ms!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Is it not gorgeous? Is it not glorious? Every year, new models of these perfect beings are born into the world, arriving right before my eyes. When ultimate beauty incarnate enters my field of vision, how could I not fall in love? Perhaps if I were blind.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: So it's not that I'm fickle. It's just that the world is overflowing with beauty. There's far too much of it. I physically can't love it all fast enough!

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: ...Please. I'm begging you. Stop using player logic to justify your idiotic mecha obsession. It's so gross.

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: I mean... there's nothing wrong with liking more things, though? We're all just pouring our love into something that makes us feel good. In that sense, we're kind of the same.

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: Absolutely not! The person I stan is a real, living, breathing wonderful human being. I live in reality! I'm nothing like Summer with her plastic model delusions!

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: Yeah. Compared to robots in plastic belts punching and kicking each other, idols who work hard, shine bright, and bring smiles to the world are way more inspiring.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: What are you even saying?! G*nd*ms don't just move. They transform!

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: And that's supposed to impress me? Amoebas can transform too! I don't see you stanning them!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Who says I don't? Among my most treasured thirteen G*nd*ms, the one ranked seventh is the Amoebo Transformer! Don't tell me you've never—

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: AAAHHHH—!!
Enya lets out a mortified wail. Sarah, on the other hand, rolls her eyes.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: You've got some nerve bringing that up. Look at the mess you left behind five years ago.

She turns, flings open the storage cabinet beside her, and hauls out a cart with a clattering rattle. It's piled high, filled to the brim with model kits, parts cases, and neatly numbered storage boxes.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: The whole five years you've been gone, we've been the ones doing dust prevention, moisture control, and Barrie-proofing. BY HAND! MANUAL LABOR! Do you have any idea what a nightmare your precious thirteen G*nd*ms have been? Do you know how much of our actual research time they've eaten up?

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: All because of that tearful little plea you made before you ran off. Enya threw herself into it completely. She used to look up to you, her "genius senior," so much. And what did you do? You didn't even warn her about the need to do pest control. Just look at her. You've traumatized the poor girl!
Summer gazes down upon the cart's abundant hoard. A heartbeat's contemplation is all it takes before she lunges at it like a starving cheetah springing on its prey.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Ohhh! My beloved RX-93, RX-78-2, MSZ-006, VXV-016, RX-0... You're still in perfect condition! I missed you so much! Sniff... I'm so sorry I left you for five whole years... You must have been so lonely...

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: ...See? This is what being a weeb does to a person. Turns your brain to mush. Phanuel is way better. She's the cutest in the world.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: Come on. Let's get away from Summer. We'll practice in another room. We still haven't nailed the fan chant. ♪~

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: ...Enya... Sarah... Barrie...
Barrie responds with a cheerful greeting, completely clueless. The other two girls, however, shudder visibly.

steps.speaker: Enya & Sarah
steps.content: Wh-what do you want? Stay back, I'm warning you—

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Thank you—!! I owe you my life!!!
Summer pounces on the girls and bowls them over in an instant. A chorus of shrieks erupts. Watching the children tangled together in chaos, your mind drifts back to earlier...

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: Don't get so full of yourself. I remember perfectly well how you slunk away in disgrace five years ago.
So... this is what that was all about? The hobbies of young geniuses truly are unfathomable.
Before you can even crack a smile, a soft, pained gasp sounds from behind you.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Ah!

It's Lemma. She's finally caught up, having pushed herself to the limit in pursuit. Her bangs are disheveled, her shoulders rise and fall with each breath, and she needs to clutch the doorframe just to keep herself upright. To add insult to injury, the moment she looks up, her eyes meet yours.
Gradually, a flush spreads across her face, blooming deeper and deeper into vivid scarlet.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...N-no... it's not what it looks like. What you see here is just... just...

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Aaaagh—don't you dare laugh!! We're mature scientists! We're by no means childish!!
The moment your laugh breaks free, the "mature and reliable" genius scientist lets out a miserable cry and flees, practically wailing as she runs.
[Special Scene]

It takes some time, but with Summer's intelligence (or rather, bald-faced betrayal), you locate her at last in a lonely, deserted corner at the hallway's end. Lemma's facing the wall, her shoulders drawn tight as bowstrings, not daring to glance back.
After a long pause, a tiny, muffled whimper escapes her.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...It's a perfectly normal way to relax... Even the most brilliant scientists need breaks. We have to engage with society. It's... not childish at all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Absolutely. Maintaining a healthy work-life balance boosts productivity.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Exactly... As long as it doesn't interfere with work. Everyone takes their responsibilities seriously. And besides, I'm keeping an eye on things.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: I'm not into idols. I don't need entertainment. I never leave my post. I am the final safeguard, mature and reliable.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I believe you. You're all exceptional scientists.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...Then stop laughing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A professional like me would never... pfft.
She whips her head around to glare at you, her face burning in a deep, furious red.

And that's all it takes to trigger her. The blonde girl winds up and pummels you with a flurry of fists. Unfortunately, her punches, soft as cotton, deal no damage to you. Looks like the little scientist hasn't exercised much.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, no, I wasn't laughing at you guys for being fans. I just think you kids are adorable.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Watching you try so hard to play the grown-up and cover for your friends... it's priceless. Pfft... "What we pursue is truth." Hahahahaha...

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: AAHHH—!
Five minutes in, her fury finally burns itself out.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't know my way around this place too well, so I couldn't find any snacks. Want to go grab some together?
She glares at you, still catching her breath.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: What's this about? Just so you know, I know exactly how you operate. Don't think for a second you can butter me up just like that.
She has a point. When she acted as EDGE-07, the two of you did nothing but argue endlessly. You've never once had a single civil conversation.
With such a jarring shift in attitude, you can't blame Lemma for quickly jumping to such a conclusion.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Or is it because you think I'm just some helpless kid now? So you're gonna act all big and patronizing?!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Don't you dare look down on me! Those three are the ones geeking out over idols. I would never be that childish! What I pursue is on a completely different plane. It's truth. TRUTH!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Okay, okay, I got it.
...And that's not childish?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't push yourself so hard, scientist. I'm here to help. If you need something, just say so.
The words shut her up instantly. She pulls back her fists, curls into a small, defensive ball, and stays that way for a long while before finally mumbling something under her breath.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...You've already been plenty of help. Thank you.

Faint bursts of laughter still drift over from the lounge area, making this corner on the other end of the hallway feel all the quieter by contrast. That sharp, bristling edge she'd had, the one ready to push back against the whole world, finally begins to soften, bit by bit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Could you give me your honest take on those data anomalies? I'd love to know what the investigator working closest with BR-003 really thinks.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...I can't say for sure. There are too many possible causes. It could be interference from leaking Mania due to proximity to the Black Ring. The last forced deterrence badly damaged our equipment, and some of those flaws still haven't been fixed. Or it could simply be a miscalculation.
She pauses, then presses on, her voice much quieter now.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Between the dimensional superposition and the Black Ring's influence, the data we collect here is overwhelmingly dense. On the other hand, the timing and frequency of these anomalies don't match the Black Ring's natural fluctuation cycles. And the equipment failures don't show any of the usual signatures either.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: There are far too many phenomena I can't reliably explain, and verifying any hypothesis feels practically impossible. Even if I could, setting up countermeasures is...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You suspect a deliberate external intrusion, don't you?
She looks up, stunned. Looks like she never expected you to actually guess it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've investigated every other Black Ring site. The Underground's activity is widespread, scattered, but I don't believe they're interested in picking through dead ruins, no. It's classic misdirection, their specialty. The real target has always been BR-003, the only Ring still active.
She says nothing. A few seconds slip by in silence, and that faint softness that had just begun to surface slowly sinks back beneath her guarded expression.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...You asked earlier why I insist on keeping BR-003 intact, knowing full well the Underground will inevitably come for it. You wanted to know why I kept stonewalling your plan to deal with it preemptively, despite the immense risks. The answer's simple.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Playing it completely safe won't get us anywhere. The Underground can operate with such freedom because their grasp of Mania dimensions is far beyond ours. EDGE has hunted them for decades and still hasn't found their hidden entry points. The gap between us is... practically generational.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Every single attack catches us completely off guard, and every pursuit comes up empty. They detonate Black Rings, and then simply vanish without a trace... They act with total impunity, and it's because we're failing. It's because we're behind a pack of lunatics, technologically.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...So that's why you're holding onto BR-003 this desperately. You see it as our best chance.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Yes. It was a stroke of pure luck, and we have to seize the opportunity. I must surpass them. I have to get to the root of the problem and rip it out. But...
She looks up, and for the very first time, genuine unease flickers in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: If these anomalies really are deliberate attacks orchestrated by them, then... they're too precise. It's all too effortless for them. Their timing is always flawless, keeping pace with our progress at every turn. And they "just happen" to bypass every single obstacle I've been stuck on.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: It's as if someone is standing far above me, calmly watching as I drag myself through the mud. They are weaponizing my own methods just to mock me. To humiliate me.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Every time they create an anomaly... It's like they're saying, "You're so slow. I can barely stand to watch anymore."
But just as you're about to press further, a shrill alarm rips through the air, tearing the silence apart in an instant.

Red warning lights flare to life one after another. A cold, mechanical drone echoes between the metal walls. Lemma's expression shifts in a heartbeat; she spins around and lunges toward the instruments beside her.

steps.speaker: Warning
steps.content: Abnormal dimensional fissure expansion in Surveillance Zone 3!
Data flickers and spikes wildly across the screen. Lemma's eyes sweep over the cascading torrent of readouts, and her pupils contract in a sudden jolt of alarm.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Wait... This Mania spectrum... it's...

A Mania dimension tears open, completely out of the blue, its signature unidentifiable, its behavior beyond all control. Fissures far exceeding testing parameters in both size and number bypass the monitoring and alert nodes, spawning one after another in rapid succession. And what emerges through them are...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Underground Puppets!

steps.speaker: Option
options: Give me the coordinates. I'll handle them!
